scenes.title: A normal day
scenes.said: Every file arrives and every check passes. Nothing waits for anyone, and Control Posture v1 is published.

scenes.title: A warning, and what to do about it
scenes.said: The scanner starts writing its words in capitals. A learned check warns, and the day still goes out, marked. Each warning's More offers to mark it as expected, tell the source or open an incident.

scenes.title: A written check holds a file, and the file sent again fills it in
scenes.said: The MFA export arrives empty and its amount holds the day: readers keep Sun 3. The vendor sends the file again overnight, and that version is published.

scenes.title: An anomaly that was real
scenes.said: A planned migration moves a third of the logging file to the cloud pipelines. A learned check holds the day, and it is published as is. The new level holds Wed 13 again until the owner accepts it; Thu 14 is judged at it.

scenes.title: An anomaly that was an issue, filled and then corrected
scenes.said: The backup export writes a third of its completed jobs as partial. A learned check holds the day, and Sunday's file is carried forward, marked as Sunday's. Two days later the corrected file arrives and replaces the fill.

scenes.title: Fills each way, and one file replaced
scenes.said: Thu 21: the TLS file comes with its rows twice, and only that file is sent again. Sat 23: the EDR file comes empty, and Sun 24's is carried back. Wed 27 is yours to decide: fill it from Wed 20, the same weekday a week before, an estimate.

scenes.title: The join that lost its applications
scenes.said: HR drops a department without moving its teams, so their applications lose their owner chain. Silver's rules hold what reads the chain until HR sends the extract again that morning.

scenes.title: One cause behind two controls
scenes.said: A certificate authority's intermediate expires, and TLS and log forwarding fail for what it issued. The platforms' share of the failures names it.
